feeds.description: Sharing simple, delicious plant-based and mostly gluten-free recipes. Minimalist Baker is about celebrating simple cooking with recipes that require 10 ingredients or less, 1 bowl, or 30 minute or less to prepare.

feeds.description: Simple, Flavorful, and Healthy Recipes from bestselling author Kelly Bejelly creator of A Girl Worth Saving. Find recipes for special diets like Gluten free.

feeds.title: Oregon Wine Press
feeds.description: Oregon Wine Press is a monthly consumer publication dedicated to Oregon wine, pinot noir, food, vineyards, winemakers, and insider-industry happenings. Established in 1984, OWP was re-imagined in 2006 by the News-Register, which is located in the heart of wine country, McMinnville, Oregon.
